name: wui-signal-analytics
title: Signal Analytics
description: Signal Analytics page (/signal-analytics): configure the datapoint elements to analyse, then show the anomalies and recurring shapes found by the signal_analytics_manager.py Python manager (matrix profile — built-in NumPy or STUMPY — or Chronos forecasting), over the archived history and continuously on live values. Joint (multivariate) analysis over several elements via mSTAMP: anomalies that only exist in the correlation between signals. Ships furnace_sim_manager.py, a batch-furnace simulator that provisions three NGA-archived elements and injects anomalies on a published schedule for verification. Page and manager exchange JSON through one SignalAnalysis datapoint per signal (no HTTP route: the WinCC OA Python API hosts no MSA vRPC service). The manager creates its own DP types and datapoints, asked over a SignalAnalyticsHub datapoint, so no other backend module is required.
